position.LEFT_RIGHT: Left or right of a tree

sections.clearing_note: Win rate of players grouped by how many of their draws came from the clearing (face-up cards) instead of the deck. This counts draws only, not all turns.
sections.clearing_x: Share of a player's draws taken from the clearing
sections.clearing_winners: Winners: share of their draws from the clearing
sections.clearing_losers: Others: share of their draws from the clearing
sections.wipes_note: When the clearing reaches 10 cards it is thrown away. Worked out from the clearing size; the Brown Bear moving the clearing into its cave counts too. It counts for the player whose action filled the clearing.
sections.wipes_triggered: Times the player emptied the clearing
sections.wipes_per_game: Times the clearing is emptied per game
sections.wipes_winners: Emptied by the winner, per game
sections.wipes_losers: Emptied by each other player, per game
sections.drivers_note: The game ends when the third winter card comes out of the deck, and the winter cards are shuffled at random into its last third. Few deck cards left at the end = the winters came late = a long game, whatever the players do. How much of the difference in game length each thing explains:
sections.drivers_x: Deck cards left at the end
sections.r2_deck: deck left at the end alone (chance)
sections.drivers_title_after: The two overlap, so the shares do not add up. Colour: how many games fall in each box.
